{{Otheruses|Level 3}}
The '''Environment shield level 3''' was an advanced [[droid shield]] designed for frontline [[Battle droid/Legends|combat droids]]. The shield provided broad spectrum protection against an array of environmental effects. Unfortunately, the power drain during its use was significant, therefore, the units needed to be replaced regularly.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 3 to be able to equip this item.
